# How to use this book {.unnumbered}

This is the main TEJ electronics book. It follows the curriculum sequence so students can move from basic measurements to circuits, components, digital logic, microcontroller inputs, and control systems.

Each chapter uses the same pattern: a simple idea, a familiar example, a schematic or block diagram, the parts of the system, the equations and units, a short GUESS example, and a check using measurement or simulation. The separate quick reference is a short printable extract for assignments and tests.

The diagrams show concepts and classroom-scale circuits. Confirm actual component data, logic voltage, current limits, pinout, polarity, and safety requirements before building.
